rows.traditional: 令 A 同 B 疏遠
rows.jyutping: ling6 A tung4 B so1 jyun5
rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when a person, action, or policy causes people to become emotionally distant from one another.

example.english: This misunderstanding was enough to alienate me from Ming, which is a real shame.
example.traditional: 呢次誤會令我同阿明疏遠咗，真係好可惜。
example.jyutping: ni1 ci3 ng6 wui6 ling6 ngo5 tung4 aa3 ming4 so1 jyun5 zo2 zan1 hai6 hou2 ho2 sik1

rows.note: Use this for voluntarily transferring ownership, property, a title, or a right to someone else.

example.english: They decided to alienate the shop by transferring ownership to someone else.
example.traditional: 佢決定將間舖轉讓畀人。
example.jyutping: keoi5 kyut3 ding6 zoeng1 gaan1 pou3 zyun2 joeng6 bei2 jan4

rows.meaning: make someone feel unable to relate
rows.traditional: 令 A 覺得格格不入
rows.jyutping: ling6 A gok3 dak1 gaak3 gaak3 bat1 jap6
rows.note: Use this when something makes a person feel that they cannot fit in or relate to the people around them.

example.english: That kind of atmosphere can alienate me and make me feel out of place.
example.traditional: 嗰種氣氛會令我覺得格格不入。
example.jyutping: go2 zung2 hei3 fan1 wui5 ling6 ngo5 gok3 dak1 gaak3 gaak3 bat1 jap6
